questions.prompt: OpenAI's data controls page names one kind of data that data residency does not apply to. Which one?

options.text: Prompts and answers sent to a project that has data residency on.
options.explanation: The page names a different exception: system data. Prompts and answers are customer content.

options.text: Nothing at all, because a chosen region covers every kind of data.
options.explanation: The page names an exception: system data.

options.text: System data, such as account details, usage statistics and billing.
options.explanation: Right. OpenAI's page says data residency does not apply to system data, which may be processed and stored outside the region.

questions.prompt: In Anthropic's data residency page, which setting says where data is stored at rest?

options.text: Inference geo, which you can change on every single request you send.
options.explanation: Inference geo controls where the model runs, not where data is stored.

options.text: Workspace geo, set when the workspace is created and never changed.
options.explanation: Right. Inference geo is the other, independent setting: it controls where the model runs.

options.text: Allowed geos, which move stored data to a new place when you edit them.
options.explanation: Allowed geos limit which inference geos a workspace may use. They do not move data.

questions.prompt: Anthropic's retention page covers customers with ZDR or HIPAA arrangements. What may Anthropic still keep?

options.text: Nothing at all, because these arrangements remove every exception to retention.
options.explanation: The page lists exceptions, so a contract should not say that nothing is ever stored.

options.text: Every prompt for 30 days, so that it can be checked for quality by staff.
options.explanation: That is not the exception. The 30-day rule applies to certain models, not to every request.

options.text: Data the law requires it to keep, and flagged inputs and outputs for up to 2 years.
options.explanation: Right. The page says flagged inputs and outputs may be retained for up to 2 years.
